context.note: The narration identifies the February 1945 destruction of Dresden as the historical event around which the fictional life is arranged.

description: Retells Vonnegut’s Slaughterhouse-Five through the narrator’s difficulty writing about Dresden, Billy Pilgrim’s captivity and postwar life, and his claimed time travel and encounters with Tralfamadorians. Preserves the novel’s uncertainty about whether its science-fiction experiences are literal or a way of surviving memory.
